scope: Read-only reconciliation of recovered source interaction behavior used by page264 acceptance planning. No WordPress write, no runtime deployment and no scope expansion.
before_after_contract: The native range input value is mirrored to the visible percentage label and the --ba-pos CSS custom property.
An image error removes the closest .ba component; no replacement implementation should be invented from acceptance tooling.

carousel_confirmed_contract.initialization: One-time data-af-carousel-init guard; current index starts at zero and go(index) applies transform, aria-hidden, data-active, dot aria-current, caption and counter state.
carousel_confirmed_contract.autoplay: start() first calls stop(), then refuses a new timer when manual, prefers-reduced-motion, disconnected, fewer than two slides or missing slides. Otherwise it starts a 4000ms interval that advances one slide.
carousel_confirmed_contract.manual_mode: manual is initialized once from c.classList.contains('carousel--manual'). User navigation does not set or mutate manual.
carousel_confirmed_contract.manual_navigation: Previous/next buttons, data-go dots, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and a qualifying horizontal swipe all call go(...) followed by start(). On a normal non-manual carousel this resets/restarts the 4000ms countdown unless another start() guard blocks it.
carousel_confirmed_contract.swipe: Pointer movement changes slide only when absolute horizontal movement is at least 40px and is not smaller than absolute vertical movement.
carousel_confirmed_contract.pause_resume: mouseenter and focusin call stop(); mouseleave and focusout call start(). Hover and focus are not tracked as independent pause flags, so compound exit order must be compared live against the source rather than redesigned.
carousel_confirmed_contract.reduced_motion: A prefers-reduced-motion change invokes start(); start() stops any old timer first and then conditionally creates a new one only if the current guards allow it.
carousel_confirmed_contract.broken_slide: Image-error drop() removes the broken slide and matching dot, reindexes remaining data-go values, clamps index, hides the enclosing .project-card__extra/.hero-proof when no slides remain, and calls go(index). drop() itself does not call stop() or start().

planning_corrections.incorrect_claim: First user navigation permanently latches autoplay off by setting manual=true.
planning_corrections.correction: False. manual comes only from the carousel--manual class at initialization. Normal user navigation ends with start(), so a non-manual carousel restarts its countdown.

planning_corrections.incorrect_claim: If runtime image removal leaves fewer than two slides, autoplay is guaranteed to stop immediately.
planning_corrections.correction: Too strong. start() will refuse a new timer when fewer than two slides exist, but drop() itself neither stops nor restarts an already-running timer. If this rare state occurs naturally, synchronized source/target observation is required.

acceptance_consequences: Use build/oldtrees-interaction-acceptance-20260915-v002.json schema >=6 as the current page264 interaction plan.
For Nordmann normal mode, verify autoplay before manual action and verify restart approximately four seconds after manual navigation rather than expecting a permanent by-user stop.
Treat carousel--manual as a distinct class-defined mode with no autoplay.
Do not synthesize broken media merely to test the error path; if it occurs naturally, compare source and target without asserting timer behavior not guaranteed by drop().
Preserve the existing runtime owner until a synchronized live source-target failure is reproduced.
wordpress_impact: NONE. These are repository acceptance/evidence corrections only; no live JavaScript, WordPress data, Additional CSS, Form33 or shared runtime was changed.
opera_impact: NONE. No browser connection, navigation or new tab was used for this reconciliation.
